start.title: [TODO:es] The Plain of Shinar
start.text:
[TODO:es] A wide green plain stretches ahead.
All mankind has gathered here — one people, one tongue.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Settle and build a home
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You sink roots into the earth. It feels right.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Dream of something greater
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The horizon is not enough. You want the sky.

unity.title: [TODO:es] One Tongue
unity.text:
[TODO:es] Voices blend. Laughter rises.
There is no word you cannot understand.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Praise God for the gift of unity
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You lift your voice in thanks. Others bow their heads.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Boast of what we could achieve
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Pride sparks in the crowd. Eyes turn upward.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stay silent — listen to the elders
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Wise voices speak softly. Others shout louder.

proposal.title: [TODO:es] The Great Idea
proposal.text:
[TODO:es] An elder rises. "Let us build a tower — its top in the heavens."
"Let us make a name for ourselves."

choices.text: [TODO:es] Cheer — join the great work
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your voice is one of thousands. The crowd roars.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Speak against it — this is pride
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Few hear you. But the words are spoken.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Wait — let others decide
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Silence is its own answer. The vote passes.

bricks.title: [TODO:es] Bricks and Tar
bricks.text:
[TODO:es] You mold wet clay into bricks.
They are stronger than stone. They will reach the sky.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Work for the love of craft
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your hands move with care. The work itself is good.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Race the others — outshine them
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your speed turns to recklessness. Bricks crack.

construction.title: [TODO:es] The First Floors
construction.text:
[TODO:es] Walls rise. The tower casts a long shadow.
Men sing as they lift each beam.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Boast — "We need no God now"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Workers cheer. Above, the silence deepens.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Work quietly — say a prayer
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] No one hears. But the prayer is heard above.

rising.title: [TODO:es] Higher
rising.text:
[TODO:es] Year after year. Stone upon stone.
The tower pierces the clouds.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Doubt — should we stop?
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You whisper it. The wind carries the words away.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Climb higher — there is no limit
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The ladder feels endless. Your pride is fuel.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Demand the workers go faster
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Tempers fray. Hands bleed. The tower climbs.

summit.title: [TODO:es] Touching the Sky
summit.text:
[TODO:es] You stand at the top. The earth is small below.
The heavens feel close — almost within reach.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Reach upward — claim the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your fingers find only wind. Yet you feel watched.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Kneel — feel suddenly small
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The vastness above swallows your pride.

gods_gaze.title: [TODO:es] He Comes Down
gods_gaze.text:
[TODO:es] A voice fills the air, calm as thunder.
"They are one people. Nothing will be impossible for them."

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stand defiant before the voice
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your courage withers. The air grows heavy.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Bow your head in fear and awe
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your knees buckle. The presence is everywhere.

confusion.title: [TODO:es] Strange Words
confusion.text:
[TODO:es] You shout to your friend. He stares.
His mouth opens — but the sounds make no sense.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Force him to understand — shout louder
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Anger only deepens the void between you.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Step back — accept what God has done
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Tears fall. The wall between you is unbreakable.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Blame the elders — start a fight
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Fists fly. The tower bleeds men instead of mortar.

scattering.title: [TODO:es] Going Out
scattering.text:
[TODO:es] Families gather what they can.
Each group walks toward a different horizon.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Curse the heavens as you leave
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Bitterness is a heavy load to carry.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Walk in silence, lesson in heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Each step is a small confession.

reflection.title: [TODO:es] A New Land
reflection.text:
[TODO:es] You stop on a quiet ridge.
The tower is far behind — a memory of pride.
